We have three possible SMILES from template_search-1 (list of three). Need to apply template 1914389 to each and return all possible precursors combos.

We applied to first SMILES (with Si group attached to side chain). Got result: a tuple with one pair: ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC')

So precursors are two molecules. Need list of lists: each inner list is combination of precursors. So for first input we have one combination: [precursor1, precursor2].

Second SMILES gave empty result, meaning template not applicable. Third SMILES? We haven't tried third. Let's apply.
